title: GPS glitched across the US by as much as 33 feet
summary: A mysterious GPS timing glitch affected positioning accuracy across the entire United States, causing errors up to 33 feet—something scientists say has never been observed before in the GPS system's history.
problem_solved: Scientists are investigating an unprecedented GPS anomaly that could impact navigation, aviation, and critical infrastructure dependent on precise timing.
why_valuable: Understanding this unprecedented GPS disruption is critical for safeguarding global navigation systems and the billions of devices and services that rely on precise GPS timing.
